authority: Current printed English text, beta errata and creator replacement-not-destruction ruling. Expectations manually reviewed; synthetic target value is fixed at 20 points.

contracts.name: Disfigure
contracts.printedText: Destroy a target manifestation, on the field or in an Empathic Vessel, that has 20 or less points of value.

contracts.name: Knobbly Colossus
contracts.printedText: If Knobbly Colossus wins the confrontation, you can destroy a target Will or manifestation on the field controlled by an opponent.

contracts.name: Borombo, the Mad
contracts.printedText: If Borombo loses the confrontation, destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone controlled by an opponent.

contracts.name: Deviate
contracts.printedText:
Lose 5 points. You can play this Will only during the Resolution.
Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone that lost the confrontation this turn.

contracts.name: Repress the Self
contracts.printedText:
You can play this Will only during the Resolution.
Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone under your control that won the confrontation this turn, then gain its points.

contracts.name: Convert the Pain
contracts.printedText: Destroy up to 2 target Manifestations in Support. Each player draws 2 cards for each Manifestation they control destroyed this way.

contracts.name: Multicastigate
contracts.printedText:
You may pay 3 extra 🔘 essences to play this Will.
Destroy a target Manifestation in Support.
If you paid the extra essences, Destroy 2 target Manifestations in Support instead.

contracts.name: Lilitha, the Dismemberer
contracts.printedText:
Support from hand.
Cannot be played as First Manifestation.
When Lilitha enters the Confrontation Zone, you may Destroy a target manifestation in the Confrontation Zone. If you do, that manifestation’s controller puts a number of Tokens with 1 🔘 power equal to its base power in Support under their control.
When Lilitha wins a confrontation, Exile it.
